name: Solar System
description: Our familiar corner of the cosmos. Eight extraordinary worlds orbit a warm yellow star.

name: Alpha Centauri
description: Golden light falls across rocky frontiers and distant ocean worlds. A new home may be waiting here.

name: Nebula Prime
description: Violet clouds conceal five enigmatic worlds, illuminated by a brilliant young star.

name: Cryon System
description: An ocean of silence. Frozen moons and crystalline worlds circle a cold blue sun.

name: Vulcan System
description: A restless red star watches over rivers of molten rock and volcanic horizons.
